control_instructions.engine: The deterministic engine owns scheduling, brief compilation, validation, gating, retries, phase transitions, and stopping.
control_instructions.isolation: Workers address only the Orchestrator; workers never address root or another worker.
control_instructions.relay: Only the Orchestrator relays worker questions and results to root; the Orchestrator cannot rewrite the mailbox and cannot mutate state.
control_instructions.root: Root remains passive after the single Orchestrator delegation, except for receiving results or relaying an engine-declared question.
